Although terbinafine is not cur- rently licensed in the UK for use in children, the BNFC suggests the following oral doses for the treatment of tinea capitis in chil- dren over 1 year of age: • in those weighing 10 to 20 kg: the equivalent of terbinafine 62.5 mg once daily • in those weighing 20 to 40 kg: 125 mg once daily • in those weighing over 40 kg: 250 mg once daily Treatment is usually given for 4 weeks for tinea capitis, 2 to 4 weeks for tinea cruris, 4 weeks for tinea corporis, and may be continued for up to 6 weeks in tinea pedis. Infections of the nails are treated for 6 weeks to 3 months, although longer treatment may occasionally be required for toe-nail infections. Similar regimens have been reported in the literature.1,2 A review on the use of terbinafine in children considered it both safe and effective in the management of tinea capitis and onychomyco- sis.3 1.
